== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns William Thomsone. The banns/marriage index records Agnes Glasgow and William Thomsone on 15 December 1681 at Carstairs.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 633/10 / 66; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
